title: SCU study of UFOs at nuclear sites

tellings.quote: SEU did a study on this. UFOs monitoring nuclear sites.

plain: UFOs were seen watching US nuclear sites, as far back as the 1940s, and a group called SCU, a coalition of scientists who study UFO reports, did a study on it. Kevin Knuth, a former NASA scientist, mentions the study in passing without going into its findings. If the pattern holds, it would suggest the objects take a particular interest in nuclear weapons.
